lifeStatusEvidence.method: Dated 2026 reporting describes the named subject participating, competing or giving an interview; life status is not inferred solely from a missing death date.

identityEvidence.reviewMethod: Named institutional or sports profiles and dated independent reporting were cross-checked with the cached identity; cached claims were treated as leads.

cachedEvidenceReview.method: The evidence cache was read as unreviewed research leads. Significant results and current life evidence were checked using the search_service_web_run tool against primary and independent sources.

portraitReview.identityBasis: The named Commons caption/description identifies Aitana Bonmatí; the described setting agrees with biographical sources. No automated face recognition or human identity certification is claimed.
portraitReview.visualReview: Actually opened and visually inspected the labeled local contact sheet .qa/add30-f/portraits.jpg. This is an actual color photograph with one clear principal subject and usable face framing. The viewed cached local bytes were copied unchanged to the public portrait asset.
portraitReview.sourceCaption: Aitana Bonmatí, the outstanding midfielder of the Spanish national football team, captivates on the red carpet in a striking red dress at the 25th Laureus World Sports Awards.

translationReview.method: Full English text was authored and read field by field against the Chinese dossier, including all concepts in the exact candidate influence rationale. Chinese and English were frozen before six complete target translations. Dates and sources remain canonical shared data; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.

editorialNotes: 2026 searches and October 30 independent reporting were used for living status. The chronology records the officially dated May 3 return, not the April date mentioned in an uncorroborated mirror.
The three consecutive Ballons d’Or are explicitly dated 2023–2025, not presented as an uninterrupted 2026 winning streak. Team honours are credited as team contributions.
Academy sources differ between age 13 and 14; UEFA’s explicit 2012/age-14 account is used for that event.
sourceAccessLimits: Search excerpts and accessible page text were used within bounded research; sources were not assumed to be fully available when only indexed excerpts or a JavaScript shell appeared.
No exhaustive daily news review or human/native-language review is asserted. Dates denote completed verified events; future announcements were not treated as results.

additionalLanguageReview.method: OpenAI Codex directly authored and semantically reviewed every target field against Chinese and English, preserving award scope, shared honours, team contributions, dated totals and career turns. Each full target was saved through reviewed-translation.save; its key/hash checks record version integrity rather than certify language quality.

dateReview.note: Corrected actual review date separately from the factual cutoff. Existing reviewed English and six-language prose reused verbatim after checking that the date correction affects no assertion; English uses explicit shared-fact delta review and six targets were saved with the reviewed save function.
